subject.title: Dashboard: new data-binding kinds — stream, command, computed

question: Should the dashboard binding roadmap include periodic command-execution bindings, or should command execution be split into a separate security-reviewed design after stream and computed bindings?
rationale: Automation cannot choose the product and security boundary for dashboard-driven command execution, and the dashboard substrate this feature extends is not yet merged.

options.title: Split Command Security Design
options.body: Proceed with stream and computed binding design after the substrate lands, and require a separate maintainer-approved proposal for command execution.

options.title: Approve All Three Binding Kinds
options.body: Allow stream, computed, and command bindings as one feature, with the implementation carrying the full allowlist, permission, audit, and proof burden.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Apps Layer
options.body: Keep the roadmap item open but pause implementation until maintainers decide whether this modular dashboard layer belongs in bundled OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Split Command Security Design
recommendation.body: Proceed with stream and computed binding design after the substrate lands, and require a separate maintainer-approved proposal for command execution.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent merged Control UI plugin-tab seam is the strongest current-main ownership signal for deciding whether this dashboard surface should expand in core/bundled UI.
